title: Globally promoting legumes by production or use subsidies
abstract: arXiv:2611.26168v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite consensus on the positive economic, environmental, and health effects of expanding legume production and consumption, the share of cropland devoted to them remains relatively small, and their share of human consumption is negligible compared with other protein sources such as meat. The presence of externalities associated with legume production and consumption gives room for policy interventions. In this context, we estimate the effects of global subsidies on legume production and consumption using CGEBox, an open-source and open-access Computable General Equilibrium modelling platform, with integrated accounting for land use, land cover, and energy, and considering agricultural and non-agricultural households. The analysis offers high agri-food detail and a special focus on Ghana and Germany, two countries with different agroecological and socioeconomic conditions facing multiple food system issues. translated_title: 通过生产或使用补贴在全球范围内推广豆类作物
translated_abstract: 尽管扩大豆类生产和消费在经济、环境和健康方面的积极影响已成共识，但专门用于豆类种植的耕地比例仍然相对较小，与肉类等其他蛋白质来源相比，其在人类消费中的占比微不足道。豆类生产和消费所涉及的外部性为政策干预提供了空间。在此背景下，我们使用CGEBox（一个开源开放获取的可计算一般均衡建模平台）估算了全球补贴对豆类生产和消费的影响，该平台整合了土地利用、土地覆盖和能源的核算，并考虑了农业和非农业家庭。该分析提供了高度细化的农业食品细节，并特别关注加纳和德国这两个农业生态和社会经济条件迥异、面临多重粮食系统问题的国家。与生产补贴相比……
tldr: 该论文利用开源可计算一般均衡模型CGEBox，整合土地利用与能源核算，评估全球豆类生产和消费补贴政策的效果，并特别关注粮食系统条件迥异的加纳和德国。
en_tdlr: This paper uses the open-source CGEBox Computable General Equilibrium platform with integrated land-use, land-cover, and energy accounting to estimate the effects of global production and consumption subsidies on legumes, with a special focus on Ghana and Germany.
